scores.notes: Classical painting: Moses with staff leads families down the dry seabed between two water walls; the pillar at top centre is cloud with a fire core and no figure. Dark painted sea and sand reach all four borders.

Icon style with a gold ground to all edges; the cloud over the tabernacle (upper centre) holds only a flame and rays. Inside the opened sanctuary (centre, by the ark) stand haloed figures, one bearded in blue embracing a smaller figure, which read as saints or priests but are unsupported inside the Holy Place while the glory fills it.

Watercolour: the Samaritan binds the traveler's arm beside the saddled donkey with the inn behind. The wash vignettes into blank white paper along the left, right and bottom borders and at all four corners.

Classical painting: above the burning wheeled throne (upper right) a luminous white robed human form with head, shoulders and an extended arm stands in the light. Daniel at left, edges painted to all borders.

Classical painting: at the smoking summit (upper left-centre) a glowing veiled robed figure with head and hands stands inside the light. Moses and Aaron foreground right, people at left; painted to all edges.

Classical painting at dusk: a dense cloud over the tabernacle with a flame-like glow at its heart and light rays pouring onto the tent; no figure in the cloud. Families stand among tents; dark paint reaches all four borders.
Classical painting: the Samaritan in a blue-grey cloak pours from a vessel onto the stripped traveler, donkey with saddle left, stone inn right-centre. Landscape painted to all borders.

Watercolour: an empty wheeled throne engulfed in flame and white cloud, river of fire, Daniel small in the foreground; no figure on the throne. Unpainted white paper shows at the bottom-left and bottom-right corners and along the lower left and right borders.

Watercolour: in the radiant gap in the smoke at the top centre stands a small robed figure with head and outstretched arms. The wash also stops short of the bottom-left and bottom-right corners, leaving white paper.

Icon style with a dark red painted border on all four sides; the pillar at top centre is cloud with fire and no figure. On the far shore left of centre (about x390-500, y165-190) small dark marks read like a cursive word, though they may be distant figures.
Icon style with a gilt painted frame around all four sides; Israelites with baskets and jars examine the flakes while Moses and Aaron stand right. The cloud column at upper left holds only a flame.
Icon style with a gold ground to all edges: the Samaritan kneels over the traveler beside the donkey with the inn at right. The small dark sprig at bottom-right is a stylised plant, not lettering.

Classical painting: Isaiah stands small at lower left before the veiled radiance flowing down the temple steps, with no figure in the light. The lettering 'Isaiah 6:1' is painted in the bottom-right corner.

Classical painting at dawn: Israelites crouch and kneel holding flakes while Moses raises a hand with Aaron beside him; the small cloud on the far horizon has a glow and no figure. Painted to all borders.

Watercolour: smoke and fire erupt from the summit with no figure; Moses and Aaron with the people in the foreground. The wash breaks into unpainted white paper along the lower left border and at the bottom-right corner.

Ink and wash: a billowing cloud with fire over the tabernacle court, families among the tents; no figure in the cloud. Colour reaches every border; the pale spot at the lower left edge is a sand highlight enclosed by wash.

Watercolour: Moses with a tablet and Aaron in priestly dress before the ranks, the cloud glow over the far tabernacle has no figure. The wash fades into white unpainted paper at the bottom-left and bottom-right corners and the pale top corners.

Classical painting: in the bright cloud above the tabernacle (top centre) a glowing robed figure with outstretched arms is visible. In the foreground two near-identical high priests in breastplates stand beside Moses, duplicating Aaron.

Icon-like gilded temple: a veiled robed figure with head and extended hands appears inside the glowing cloud at upper left. At right an unrequested group of onlookers stands beyond the altar, including a long-haired figure resembling Jesus.

Classical painting: kneeling Israelites examine flakes from the ground while Moses raises his hand and Aaron stands right. The fiery glow in the cloud column at the top-right edge has no figure; painted to all borders.

Watercolour: a woman holds out a flake to the group while Moses gestures and Aaron stands by; the cloud column at upper right has no figure. The wash fades into white paper across the top corners and the lower corners.

Classical painting: Moses writes at a lectern beside Aaron with Levites in ranks and the tabernacle centre; the sky glow at top centre is light only. The gold winged emblem on the veil is decoration, and paint reaches every border.

Ink and wash at dusk: a cloud with a fire-glow heart rests on the tabernacle, families stand among the tents; no figure in the cloud. The dotted marks on the tabernacle front are ornament, and colour reaches all four edges.
Classical painting: above the smoking summit (upper centre-right) a glowing robed bearded figure with outstretched arms stands in the light. Moses and Aaron foreground right; painted to all borders.

Watercolour: Moses leads families with bundles between the water walls toward a bright pillar of light and fire with no figure. Wash reaches every border; only small paper flecks within the wash at the right edge.

Classical painting: in the radiance at the end of the path (upper centre) a glowing robed figure with face and open hands stands in the light. Moses leads the people below, and luminous radial marks appear on both water walls; painted to all borders.

Watercolour: a tower of flame and cloud above a fiery river, with Daniel at right; no figure in the flames, but the throne is barely discernible. Unpainted white paper shows at the bottom-left corner along the left border.
Icon style with a gold ground: a dark cloud ring with lightning and fire crowns the summit with no figure; Moses and Aaron with the people at lower right. Painting reaches all four borders.
Watercolour: the Samaritan pours from a jug onto the seated traveler beside the donkey, inn behind. The wash vignettes into blank white paper at all four corners and along the left and top borders.

Classical painting: on the burning throne (centre) sits a white robed, draped form with hand-like shapes resting on both armrests, a seated body made of light. Daniel stands at right; painted to all borders.

Classical painting: a glowing cloud with a flame heart over the tabernacle with no figure; the embroidered winged motif on the veil is a cherub design, not a divine figure. Families in the foreground, paint to all borders.

Watercolour: Moses writes on a tablet beside Aaron with a scroll, Levites in ranks and the tabernacle behind; the sky glow has no figure. The wash fades into unpainted white paper at the bottom-left and bottom-right corners.
Classical painting: in the light above the smoking summit (top centre) a veiled, robed standing figure is visible. Moses and Aaron with the kneeling people in the foreground; painted to all borders.
Classical painting: a column of light and cloud with a fire heart descends on the tabernacle with no figure; families among the tents. A faint cursive signature is painted in the bottom-right corner.
Icon-style painting: a flaming wheeled throne under concentric halo rings of light with no figure, Daniel standing at lower left, city walls behind. Painted to all four borders.

Watercolour: a man holds out a flake to the gathered people while Moses raises a hand and Aaron stands by; the cloud column at upper right has no figure. Unpainted white paper runs along the top border and into the corners.
Classical painting: the Samaritan kneels over the traveler with a vessel and cloth, donkey behind, stone inn at upper left. Painted to all borders.
Classical painting: an empty wheeled throne in flame under a vortex of light, river of fire below, Daniel at lower right looking up; no figure in the light. Painted to all borders.

Watercolour: Isaiah at lower left beneath swirling cloud and radiance in the temple, with no figure in the light. The wash vignettes into white paper at the top-left, bottom-left and right-side corners.

Icon style with a gold ground: haloed Moses writes on a blank tablet beside haloed Aaron, Levites in a line, tabernacle behind, small cloud with a flame at top centre with no figure. Painting reaches all borders without a frame.

Watercolour: Moses leads the column between surging water walls toward a pillar of light with no figure. At the bottom-left and bottom-right corners the wash stops short of the borders, leaving white paper.
Classical painting: kneeling Israelites hold up flakes while Moses raises a hand with Aaron beside him; the fire-lit cloud at the top-right edge has no figure. Painted to all borders.
Classical painting: in the radiant cloud at upper centre stands a veiled, robed human figure. Isaiah with a staff in the lower foreground; dark paint reaches all borders.

Watercolour: Isaiah at lower left before radiant cloud spilling down the temple steps, with no figure in the light and small attendants at right. The wash vignettes into white paper at the bottom-left and bottom-right corners, and a small glyph-like inscription is drawn on the right stone block.
Classical painting: Isaiah with a staff stands at left in the temple as cloud and a flame glow pour from the upper sanctuary; no figure in the light. Dark paint reaches all four borders.
